proposal.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Add Java 25 image targets for WildFly 41.0.1.Final and Payara Community Full 7.2026.9 without removing older-server coverage. This is PR 1 of the image-publication/test-registration split.

- **Images:** HotSpot on Linux and Windows; OpenJ9 on Linux. Reuse `servlet-5.0`, pin the verified Payara digest, and retain existing JDK pins; OpenJ9 meets Payara’s minimum.
- **WildFly extraction:** Select ZIP for 41.0.1.Final, whose Maven distribution has no tar.gz. Preserve tar.gz extraction for older releases.
- **Validation:** Four Linux images built and passed deployment and manual agent-backed propagation, async, error, static-resource, and JSP-injection checks. Older WildFly tar extraction also passed. Windows validation is limited to task registration and archive inspection.
- **Handoff:** After merge, wait for the complete servlet-image publication and verify all six images under its actual shared tag. Test registrations, full inherited JUnit runs, the shared image pin, and matrix documentation remain for PR 2.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- First part of #14960
